original_target.title: Does an indicator Gabor basis force tiling and spectrality?

scope_comparison: Liehr Theorem1.1 classifies lattices in R2 for compactly supported one-dimensional windows. This leaves arbitrary d, unbounded finite-measure indicator K and nonlattice countable Lambda. Its nonproduct-realization counterexample is a fractional-Fourier window, not an indicator. Product sufficient conditions do not prove the general necessity of both tiling and spectrality.
